### Example Code

```python
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import FastAPI, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()

class PaginatedParams(BaseModel):
    is_paginated: bool = Field(True)
    page: int = Field(1, alias='current')
    size: int = Field(10, alias='pageSize')
@app.get("/")
def read_root(paginated: Annotated[PaginatedParams, Query()]):
    return paginated
```

answer.body:
This is FastAPI bug. Alias parameter doesn't work for query parameters in Pydantic model.

There is the issue already: https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/issues/12402
